title: Shorter Listing Expiry Periods for Higher Seller Performance Standing Levels
content:
**Starting period.** The listing expiry period starts from the top-level expiry period of 4 whole calendar months for a seller placed at Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level with no listing-type violation recorded in the last three whole calendar months, and from the mid-level expiry period of 5 whole calendar months for a seller placed at Standard Level or Above Standard Level with no listing-type violation recorded in that period. For any other seller neither of these shorter starting periods applies.

Listing-type violations under Seller Performance Standing are listing policy and restricted product violations. Whole calendar months are counted by calendar date back from the handling date: a violation lies in the last three whole calendar months when fewer than three whole months have passed from its recording date to the handling date.

## Conditions in combination

| Level the seller is placed at | Listing-type violation recorded in the last three whole calendar months | Starting period |
|---|---|---|
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | none | 4 months |
| Top Rated Level or Preferred Partner Level | one or more | neither shorter period |
| Standard Level or Above Standard Level | none | 5 months |
| Standard Level or Above Standard Level | one or more | neither shorter period |
| Developing Seller Level or Below Standard Level | any | neither shorter period |

## On the three-month boundary (hypothetical handling date 15 September)

- A Preferred Partner Level seller whose latest listing-type violation was recorded on 15 June: three whole months have passed, the violation is outside the last three months, and the period starts from 4 months.
- The same seller with the violation recorded on 16 June: it lies inside the last three months, and the 4-month starting period does not apply.
- A Top Rated Level seller with an intellectual property violation recorded last month and no listing-type violation in the period: the intellectual property violation is not listing-type, so the period starts from 4 months.
